Apple launched the second public beta of iOS 27.2, introducing a brand-new iPhone Health app.

iOS 27.2 beta adds new Health app and other features

iOS 27.2 will be the next version following the official launch of iOS 27 on September 14. iOS 27.1 is only available for iPhone Duo.

The first public beta of iOS 27.2 includes the following changes:

  • The redesigned Health app, first announced by Apple at the iPhone 18 Pro launch event, has now made its debut in this beta.
  • Group FaceTime adds a dual-camera shooting mode.
  • Siri AI language support adds French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish.
  • Apple TV app profile feature arrives on iPhone.
  • Apple Podcasts' "Up Next" has been changed to "Latest Episodes", with the "Continue Playing" section moved directly below "Latest Episodes". The podcast episode list also features backgrounds that match the theme colours.
  • Apple Music now uses fewer icon colours in its tabs.

iOS 27.2 is expected to be officially released at the end of this month. iPhone users who want an early look at the new Apple Health app can now participate in testing through the developer beta or public beta channels.
